title: Record the outer-product mask weight
body:
## Summary
- Writing the second mask into each set bit of the first, with stride equal to the second width, produces a mask whose weight is the product of the two weights.
- This holds for all 8,408,068 pairs whose widths multiply to at most 20. For all 27 shapes with both widths at least 2, a stride one shorter makes the all-ones masks collide.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
